endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: Judicial desire for speed may support sustainment even if attorney trust remains mixed.

meta.important_question: Does the volunteer intake triage program become a sustained core workflow, remain a narrow supervised pilot, or get rolled back?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: This is the clearest terminal organizational choice implied by the scenario.
realization_criteria: Formal office policy or repeated operations establish volunteer triage beyond a pilot window.
Volunteer roles remain active across multiple reporting periods or case cohorts.
Leadership communications frame triage as standard workflow rather than temporary trial.
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: The scenario states launch pressure exists, but long-term institutionalization is unresolved.

blockers: continued court impatience for larger speed gains
endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: If delay pressure intensifies sharply, pilot limits may be seen as insufficient.
endpoint_ledger.description: The office retains the program only in limited scope with explicit attorney oversight and constrained volunteer authority.
endpoint_ledger.label: Narrow Supervised Pilot

meta.important_question: Who ultimately controls triage design at equilibrium: office leadership and operations, or attorneys through supervision and scope limits?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: This endpoint preserves both service experimentation and professional safeguards.
realization_criteria: Written scope limits define volunteer tasks and prohibited actions.
Attorney supervision is required for consequential triage decisions.
Program reporting identifies pilot status or restricted deployment rather than office-wide normalization.
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: Attorney quality concerns make a constrained compromise highly plausible at T0.

blockers: funder and court pressure to show reform
endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: Rollback may reduce quality risk yet worsen delay pressure, generating external backlash.
endpoint_ledger.description: The office pauses, materially shrinks, or abandons volunteer triage after conflict, poor performance, or legitimacy concerns.
endpoint_ledger.label: Program Rollback or Suspension

meta.important_question: At observable outcome level, does the program improve intake speed and delay performance without documented quality breakdowns?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: Abandonment remains a credible terminal option if implementation fails.
realization_criteria: Leadership announces suspension, rollback, or termination of volunteer triage.
Volunteer onboarding ceases or active triage roles are revoked.
Operational workflow reverts primarily to attorney-controlled intake without volunteer triage participation.
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: The conflict is real, but source text does not establish a decisive failure at T0.

blockers: quality concerns not captured by dashboards
endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: The program could continue internally even if funder enthusiasm weakens, depending on other resources.
endpoint_ledger.description: Funder support continues only if the office produces acceptable performance metrics linked to the triage model.
endpoint_ledger.label: Metrics-Conditioned Funding Continuity

meta.important_question: Does continued funder support become tied to a metrics-validated model, or does support weaken because results are inconclusive or contested?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: Funding leverage is an implied endpoint pressure, not just a process detail.
realization_criteria: Funders renew, extend, or maintain support explicitly citing reported program metrics.
Funding communications condition continuation on measurable throughput, timeliness, or related indicators.
Office reporting systems become embedded in program governance due to funding requirements.
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: Funders clearly want metrics, but no funding decision has occurred yet.
